question: What elements constitute the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The eight are included as a constituent element.
The attainment of powers is included as a constituent element.
These elements are identified as the root Kaula.
inference: The eight and the attainment of powers together constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight is not specified within this verse alone.
The internal syntactic relation within the fused token siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ allows more than one precise parsing.
plain_english: And the eight, along with the attainment of powers, are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
